guards.FAILED->QUEUED: retrySafe=true; zero segments accepted confirmed; attemptCount<3; permissions/policy/entitlement/expiry revalidated
guards.PARTIAL->SENT: new evidence confirms every segment sent; no new physical invocation
guards.PARTIAL->DELIVERED: new evidence confirms every segment delivered; no new physical invocation
guards.PARTIAL->FAILED: correction by evidence proving zero segments accepted; reviewed and audited; no automatic retry
guards.UNKNOWN->FAILED: evidence proving zero segments accepted; retrySafe evaluated separately
guards.LEASED->QUEUED: grant never issued and native INVOKING never happened
guards.SUSPENDED->QUEUED: explicit authorized review; message not expired; actor/resource valid
guards.SENT->DELIVERED: delivery success confirmed for every segment

invariants: No automatic retry from PARTIAL or UNKNOWN
SMS send and delivery are distinct
Replaying events/webhooks never sends SMS again
